observedCues.before: A green-lit closed door is ahead.
observedCues.action: The door opens and the player walks into the corridor, where the view tilts down toward supply objects.
observedCues.result: The player looks up and reaches the next opening. Use the observed sequence to introduce door, supply and continuing route as distinct functions.
observedCues.editorialGuide: Attach the doorway and supply callouts only while visible, at the corresponding speech cues. Keep both source HUD corners and the fixed caption zone free. Use the 16:9 recording proportionally within the vertical layout.
observedCues.observationLimit: A floor pickup and nearby doorway are visible. The clip cannot establish resource gained, developer intent, compulsory pickup or whether another door connects to the same space.

observedCues.before: Samus is visible in a stepped Artaria passage at local frame 2758. The Artaria map opens, zooms into the passage and shows its explored shape and visible icons at frames 2818–3237.
observedCues.action: The view returns to the passage at frame 3297. Sampled frames show Samus aiming upward from the lower right and the game then confirms the item acquisition.
observedCues.result: At frame 3657 the game identifies a Missile Tank and a capacity increase of two. At frame 3777 Samus is at the right-hand door with 17/17 displayed instead of 15/15.
observedCues.editorialUse: Follow the map-to-passage order. Compare what the game map depicts with the route and pickup actually seen on screen. Derive the separate observation sketch from visible geometry only. Keep the in-game map, item message and HUD readable and use the original 16:9 frame within the vertical layout.
observedCues.limits: The automatic in-game map is distinct from the authored observation diagram. Do not claim the map directed the player, exposed all unseen connections, or proves player intent. Preserve the observed order. Runtime and visual annotation need a full playback review.
